scripts.text:
[Card Seller]
I am sorry, it seems like something went wrong.
I cannot find any cards in our database at the moment.
Please contact a game master.
scripts.translation:
[卡片商人]
很抱歉，似乎出了点问题。
目前我在数据库中找不到任何卡片。
请联系游戏管理员。

scripts.text:
[Card Seller]
Welcome!
I can sell you any normal monster card in the game. Would you like to have a look?
scripts.translation:
[卡片商人]
欢迎光临！
我可以出售游戏中的任何普通怪物卡片。
你想看看吗？
